clips.title: The story
paras: The Alexston Farmstead is a derelict farm in Westfall, overgrown and prowled by haywire Harvest Watchers. Once the childhood home of Stormwind's city architect, Baros Alexston, it has fallen into ruin like much of the breadbasket around it.

Situated amidst the dry plains of Westfall, the Alexston Farmstead stands as another grim testament to the kingdom's neglect. Like neighboring estates, the farm was abandoned by its caretakers when banditry erupted across the countryside. Today, the fields are overgrown, and the mechanical Harvest Watchers left behind to tend the crops have spun out of control, violently attacking anyone who approaches the barren farmhouse.

Despite its bleak state, the farm is tied to one of Stormwind's most prominent citizens. Baros Alexston, the skilled architect who helped design parts of the rebuilt capital, spent his youth toiling on these very fields. He left the farmstead long before the unrest began to pursue his trade in masonry and construction, leaving behind a memento of his early life nestled among the ruins.
